shots.text: THEY DID NOT LIVE IN CAVES
bakedWords: THEY DID NOT LIVE IN CAVES

shots.text: SO THAT IS WHERE WE LOOK
THEY DID NOT ALL DIE AT 30
YOU HAVE SEEN THIS ON A SHIRT
AND WE CAN NAME THE PLANT
HELD IN MIND, TEN STEPS BACK
THE ICE WAS ONLY UP THERE
NOT A FUR ON A SHOULDER
FOUND IN ICE, SO WE ASSUMED
A CUT HAND, AND A FULL STOMACH
TALKING ABOUT WHAT IS NOT THERE
THAT IS THE STORY WE INHERIT
